```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Filter to your focal species (check names first!)
species_data <- data %>%
  filter(Species %in% c("Peromyscus maniculatus",
                        "Dipodomys merriami",
                        "Microtus oregoni")) %>%   # pick an existing Microtus
  mutate(time = paste(Year, Month, sep = "-")) %>%
  drop_na(Abundance_estimate)

# Step 2: Aggregate by time and species (if multiple observations per month)
# Use sum or mean – here using sum (total abundance at that time)
agg_data <- species_data %>%
  group_by(time, Species) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance_estimate), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Pivot to wide format
pivot_data <- agg_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Abundance)

# Check that all three columns exist
names(pivot_data)

# Step 4: Run your models (replace with actual column names)
model1 <- lm(`Peromyscus maniculatus` ~ `Dipodomys merriami`, data = pivot_data)
summary(model1)

model2 <- lm(`Peromyscus maniculatus` ~ `Dipodomys merriami` + `Microtus oregoni`, data = pivot_data)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# INTERSPECIFIC COMPETITION ANALYSIS
# Linearized discrete-time Lotka-Volterra model
# ============================================================

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)  # for nice coefficient tables

# ---------- 1. Prepare data (if not already done) ----------
# Assuming your original pivoted data is called 'pivot_data'
# with columns: time, Peromyscus maniculatus, Dipodomys merriami, Microtus oregoni

# If you don't have comp_data yet, run this:
comp_data <- pivot_data %>%
  arrange(time) %>%
  # Add small constant to avoid log(0) if any zeros exist
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . + 0.001)) %>%
  # Create lagged columns (abundance at previous time point)
  mutate(across(c(`Peromyscus maniculatus`, `Dipodomys merriami`, `Microtus oregoni`),
                .fns = list(lag1 = ~ lag(.)),
                .names = "{.col}_lag1")) %>%
  drop_na()  # remove first time point where lag is NA

# ---------- 2. Compute log ratios (per capita growth rate) ----------
comp_data <- comp_data %>%
  mutate(
    log_ratio_PM = log(`Peromyscus maniculatus` / `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1`),
    log_ratio_DM = log(`Dipodomys merriami` / `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`),
    log_ratio_MO = log(`Microtus oregoni` / `Microtus oregoni_lag1`)
  )

# ---------- 3. Fit linear competition models for each species ----------

# Model for Peromyscus maniculatus
lm_compet_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

# Model for Dipodomys merriami
lm_compet_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

# Model for Microtus oregoni
lm_compet_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

# ---------- 4. Extract and back-transform parameters ----------

# Function to compute ecological parameters from linear model coefficients
# b0 = r, b1 = -r/K, b2 = -r*α12/K, b3 = -r*α13/K
extract_competition_params <- function(lm_model, species_name) {
  coefs <- coef(lm_model)
  b0 <- coefs[1]          # r
  b1 <- coefs[2]          # -r/K (effect of own lag)
  b2 <- coefs[3]          # -r*α_competitor1/K
  b3 <- coefs[4]          # -r*α_competitor2/K
  
  r <- b0
  K <- -b0 / b1
  alpha_comp1 <- b2 / b1
  alpha_comp2 <- b3 / b1
  
  # Get p-values for competition coefficients
  pvals <- summary(lm_model)$coefficients[,4]
  
  return(data.frame(
    Species = species_name,
    r = r,
    K = K,
    alpha_comp1 = alpha_comp1,
    alpha_comp2 = alpha_comp2,
    p_comp1 = pvals[3],
    p_comp2 = pvals[4]
  ))
}

params_PM <- extract_competition_params(lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus maniculatus")
params_DM <- extract_competition_params(lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys merriami")
params_MO <- extract_competition_params(lm_compet_MO, "Microtus oregoni")

# Combine into one table
competition_results <- bind_rows(params_PM, params_DM, params_MO)
print(competition_results)

# ---------- 5. Confidence intervals for parameters ----------

# Function to get confidence intervals for back-transformed parameters
# (using delta method approximation via confint on linear model)
confint_competition <- function(lm_model, species_name) {
  ci_linear <- confint(lm_model)
  b0_ci <- ci_linear[1,]
  b1_ci <- ci_linear[2,]
  b2_ci <- ci_linear[3,]
  b3_ci <- ci_linear[4,]
  
  # Back-transform intervals (r = b0, K = -b0/b1, α = b2/b1)
  r_ci <- b0_ci
  K_ci <- -b0_ci / b1_ci
  alpha1_ci <- b2_ci / b1_ci
  alpha2_ci <- b3_ci / b1_ci
  
  return(data.frame(
    Species = species_name,
    r_lower = r_ci[1], r_upper = r_ci[2],
    K_lower = K_ci[1], K_upper = K_ci[2],
    alpha1_lower = alpha1_ci[1], alpha1_upper = alpha1_ci[2],
    alpha2_lower = alpha2_ci[1], alpha2_upper = alpha2_ci[2]
  ))
}

ci_PM <- confint_competition(lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus maniculatus")
ci_DM <- confint_competition(lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys merriami")
ci_MO <- confint_competition(lm_compet_MO, "Microtus oregoni")

ci_results <- bind_rows(ci_PM, ci_DM, ci_MO)
print(ci_results)

# ---------- 6. Model comparison: single-species vs. competition ----------

# Single-species (density-dependent) models
lm_single_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1`, data = comp_data)
lm_single_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`, data = comp_data)
lm_single_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ `Microtus oregoni_lag1`, data = comp_data)

# Compare using ANOVA and AIC
compare_models <- function(single_model, compet_model, species) {
  aic <- AIC(single_model, compet_model)
  anova_p <- anova(single_model, compet_model)$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  return(data.frame(Species = species, AIC_single = aic$AIC[1], 
                    AIC_compet = aic$AIC[2], anova_p = anova_p))
}

comparison <- bind_rows(
  compare_models(lm_single_PM, lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus maniculatus"),
  compare_models(lm_single_DM, lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys merriami"),
  compare_models(lm_single_MO, lm_compet_MO, "Microtus oregoni")
)
print(comparison)

# ---------- 7. Plot zero-growth isoclines for the two strongest competitors ----------
# (choose the pair with significant competition based on p-values)

# Example for Peromyscus vs Dipodomys (assuming they are significant)
# Get parameters from competition_results
r_PM <- params_PM$r
K_PM <- params_PM$K
alpha_PM_DM <- params_PM$alpha_comp1   # effect of Dipodomys on Peromyscus

# For Dipodomys, need alpha of Peromyscus on Dipodomys
alpha_DM_PM <- params_DM$alpha_comp1   # effect of Peromyscus on Dipodomys
K_DM <- params_DM$K

# Create isocline functions
isocline_PM <- function(N_DM) K_PM - alpha_PM_DM * N_DM
isocline_DM <- function(N_PM) K_DM - alpha_DM_PM * N_PM

# Create a data frame for plotting
N_range <- seq(0, max(comp_data$`Peromyscus maniculatus`, comp_data$`Dipodomys merriami`), length.out = 100)

isocline_data <- data.frame(
  N_DM = N_range,
  N_PM_isocline = isocline_PM(N_range),
  N_PM_for_DM = N_range,
  N_DM_isocline = isocline_DM(N_range)
)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_path(data = comp_data, aes(x = `Dipodomys merriami`, y = `Peromyscus maniculatus`), 
            alpha = 0.5, arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.1, "inches"))) +
  geom_point(data = comp_data, aes(x = `Dipodomys merriami`, y = `Peromyscus maniculatus`, color = time)) +
  geom_line(data = isocline_data, aes(x = N_DM, y = N_PM_isocline), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = isocline_data, aes(x = N_PM_for_DM, y = N_DM_isocline), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(x = "Dipodomys merriami abundance", y = "Peromyscus maniculatus abundance",
       title = "Zero-growth isoclines: Peromyscus vs Dipodomys",
       subtitle = "Blue: Peromyscus isocline, Red: Dipodomys isocline") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate("text", x = max(comp_data$`Dipodomys merriami`)*0.8, y = max(comp_data$`Peromyscus maniculatus`)*0.9,
           label = ifelse(alpha_PM_DM > 0 & alpha_DM_PM > 0, "Possible coexistence if isoclines cross", 
                          "Competitive exclusion likely"))

# ---------- 8. Check model assumptions ----------
# Residual plots - view one at a time (press Enter in console to advance)
plot(lm_compet_PM, which = 1)  # residuals vs fitted
plot(lm_compet_PM, which = 2)  # Q-Q plot
plot(lm_compet_PM, which = 3)  # scale-location
plot(lm_compet_PM, which = 4)  # Cook's distance

# Test for temporal autocorrelation in residuals
acf_resid_PM <- acf(residuals(lm_compet_PM), plot = TRUE, main = "ACF of residuals - Peromyscus")
# If significant lag 1 autocorrelation, note as limitation

# ---------- 9. Summary report for your project ----------

cat("\n========== INTERSPECIFIC COMPETITION RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("\nParameters (r = intrinsic growth rate, K = carrying capacity, α = competition coefficient)\n")
print(competition_results)

cat("\n\nInterpretation:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(competition_results)) {
  sp <- competition_results$Species[i]
  a1 <- competition_results$alpha_comp1[i]
  a2 <- competition_results$alpha_comp2[i]
  p1 <- competition_results$p_comp1[i]
  p2 <- competition_results$p_comp2[i]
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", sp))
  cat(sprintf("  - r = %.3f, K = %.1f\n", competition_results$r[i], competition_results$K[i]))
  if(p1 < 0.05) cat(sprintf("  - Significant competition from competitor 1 (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a1, p1))
  else cat(sprintf("  - No significant competition from competitor 1 (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a1, p1))
  if(p2 < 0.05) cat(sprintf("  - Significant competition from competitor 2 (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a2, p2))
  else cat(sprintf("  - No significant competition from competitor 2 (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a2, p2))
}

cat("\nModel comparison (single-species vs. competition):\n")
print(comparison)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# INTERSPECIFIC COMPETITION ANALYSIS - COMPLETE SCRIPT
# Linearized discrete-time Lotka-Volterra model
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

# ---------- 1. Prepare data (assumes pivot_data exists) ----------
# Add small constant to avoid log(0) and infinite values
pivot_data_adj <- pivot_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . + 0.1))

# Create time-ordered dataset with lagged abundances
comp_data <- pivot_data_adj %>%
  arrange(time) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Peromyscus maniculatus`, `Dipodomys merriami`, `Microtus oregoni`),
                .fns = list(lag1 = ~ lag(.)),
                .names = "{.col}_lag1")) %>%
  drop_na()  # remove first time point

# Check that we have enough data
if(nrow(comp_data) < 5) stop("Not enough time points after creating lags.")

# ---------- 2. Compute log ratios (per capita growth rate) ----------
comp_data <- comp_data %>%
  mutate(
    log_ratio_PM = log(`Peromyscus maniculatus` / `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1`),
    log_ratio_DM = log(`Dipodomys merriami` / `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`),
    log_ratio_MO = log(`Microtus oregoni` / `Microtus oregoni_lag1`)
  )

# Remove any rows where log ratios are infinite (rare, but safe)
comp_data <- comp_data %>%
  filter(is.finite(log_ratio_PM), is.finite(log_ratio_DM), is.finite(log_ratio_MO))

if(nrow(comp_data) < 3) stop("Too few finite log ratios after filtering.")

# ---------- 3. Fit linear competition models ----------
lm_compet_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

lm_compet_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

lm_compet_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`,
                   data = comp_data)

# ---------- 4. Extract and back‑transform parameters ----------
extract_params <- function(model, species_name, comp1_name, comp2_name) {
  coefs <- coef(model)
  if(any(is.na(coefs))) return(data.frame(Species = species_name, r = NA, K = NA, 
                                          alpha_comp1 = NA, alpha_comp2 = NA,
                                          p_comp1 = NA, p_comp2 = NA))
  b0 <- coefs[1]
  b1 <- coefs[2]  # own lag
  b2 <- coefs[3]  # competitor 1
  b3 <- coefs[4]  # competitor 2
  
  r <- b0
  K <- -b0 / b1
  alpha1 <- b2 / b1
  alpha2 <- b3 / b1
  
  pvals <- summary(model)$coefficients[,4]
  p1 <- ifelse(length(pvals) >= 3, pvals[3], NA)
  p2 <- ifelse(length(pvals) >= 4, pvals[4], NA)
  
  return(data.frame(Species = species_name, r = r, K = K, 
                    alpha_comp1 = alpha1, alpha_comp2 = alpha2,
                    p_comp1 = p1, p_comp2 = p2))
}

params_PM <- extract_params(lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus maniculatus", "Dipodomys", "Microtus")
params_DM <- extract_params(lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys merriami", "Peromyscus", "Microtus")
params_MO <- extract_params(lm_compet_MO, "Microtus oregoni", "Peromyscus", "Dipodomys")

competition_results <- bind_rows(params_PM, params_DM, params_MO)

# ---------- 5. Model comparison (single-species vs. competition) ----------
lm_single_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1`, data = comp_data)
lm_single_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`, data = comp_data)
lm_single_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ `Microtus oregoni_lag1`, data = comp_data)

compare_models <- function(single, compet, sp_name) {
  aic <- AIC(single, compet)
  anova_p <- tryCatch(anova(single, compet)$`Pr(>F)`[2], error = function(e) NA)
  return(data.frame(Species = sp_name, 
                    AIC_single = aic$AIC[1], 
                    AIC_compet = aic$AIC[2],
                    delta_AIC = aic$AIC[2] - aic$AIC[1],
                    anova_p = anova_p))
}

comparison <- bind_rows(
  compare_models(lm_single_PM, lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus maniculatus"),
  compare_models(lm_single_DM, lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys merriami"),
  compare_models(lm_single_MO, lm_compet_MO, "Microtus oregoni")
)

# ---------- 6. Zero‑growth isoclines (only if parameters are valid) ----------
# Only for Peromyscus vs Dipodomys (example)
K_PM <- params_PM$K
K_DM <- params_DM$K
alpha_PM_DM <- params_PM$alpha_comp1   # effect of Dipodomys on Peromyscus
alpha_DM_PM <- params_DM$alpha_comp1   # effect of Peromyscus on Dipodomys

# Check if parameters are finite and positive
if(all(is.finite(c(K_PM, K_DM, alpha_PM_DM, alpha_DM_PM))) && 
   K_PM > 0 && K_DM > 0 && alpha_PM_DM > -10 && alpha_DM_PM > -10) {
  
  # Create isocline functions (only positive part)
  isocline_PM <- function(N_DM) pmax(K_PM - alpha_PM_DM * N_DM, 0)
  isocline_DM <- function(N_PM) pmax(K_DM - alpha_DM_PM * N_PM, 0)
  
  # Get ranges
  x_max <- max(comp_data$`Dipodomys merriami`, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  y_max <- max(comp_data$`Peromyscus maniculatus`, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  
  N_seq <- seq(0, x_max, length.out = 100)
  iso1 <- isocline_PM(N_seq)
  
  N_seq2 <- seq(0, y_max, length.out = 100)
  iso2 <- isocline_DM(N_seq2)
  
  # Plot
  p_isocline <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = comp_data, 
              aes(x = `Dipodomys merriami`, y = `Peromyscus maniculatus`), 
              alpha = 0.5, arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.1, "inches"))) +
    geom_point(data = comp_data, 
               aes(x = `Dipodomys merriami`, y = `Peromyscus maniculatus`, color = time)) +
    geom_line(data = data.frame(N_DM = N_seq, N_PM = iso1), 
              aes(x = N_DM, y = N_PM), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_line(data = data.frame(N_PM = N_seq2, N_DM = iso2), 
              aes(x = N_DM, y = N_PM), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, x_max), ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(x = "Dipodomys merriami abundance", y = "Peromyscus maniculatus abundance",
         title = "Zero‑growth isoclines: Peromyscus vs Dipodomys",
         subtitle = "Blue: Peromyscus isocline, Red: Dipodomys isocline") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p_isocline)
} else {
  cat("\nCannot plot isoclines because K or alpha values are invalid.\n")
  cat("Check competition_results table for NA or unrealistic values.\n")
}

# ---------- 7. Print summary results ----------
cat("\n========== INTERSPECIFIC COMPETITION RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("\nParameters (r = intrinsic growth rate, K = carrying capacity, α = competition coefficient)\n")
print(round(competition_results, 4))

cat("\n\nInterpretation:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(competition_results)) {
  sp <- competition_results$Species[i]
  r <- competition_results$r[i]
  K <- competition_results$K[i]
  a1 <- competition_results$alpha_comp1[i]
  a2 <- competition_results$alpha_comp2[i]
  p1 <- competition_results$p_comp1[i]
  p2 <- competition_results$p_comp2[i]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: r = %.3f, K = %.1f\n", sp, r, K))
  if(!is.na(p1) && p1 < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Significant competition from first competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a1, p1))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ No significant competition from first competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a1, p1))
  }
  if(!is.na(p2) && p2 < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Significant competition from second competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a2, p2))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ No significant competition from second competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", a2, p2))
  }
}

cat("\n\nModel comparison (single‑species vs. competition):\n")
print(round(comparison, 3))

cat("\n\nInterpretation of model comparison:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(comparison)) {
  sp <- comparison$Species[i]
  delta <- comparison$delta_AIC[i]
  if(!is.na(delta) && delta < -2) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: Competition model is strongly favored (ΔAIC = %.1f).\n", sp, delta))
  } else if(!is.na(delta) && delta > 2) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: Single‑species model is favored (ΔAIC = %.1f).\n", sp, delta))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: Models are similar (ΔAIC = %.1f).\n", sp, delta))
  }
}

cat("\n========== END OF COMPETITION ANALYSIS ==========\n")
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMPETITION ANALYSIS – POOLED ACROSS SITES
# Linearized discrete-time Lotka-Volterra with site effects
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

# ---------- 1. Load and filter your raw data ----------
# Assuming your original data frame is called 'data' (from the CSV)
# Replace 'data' with your actual data frame name if different.

# Define your three focal species (use names exactly as in your CSV)
focal_species <- c("Peromyscus maniculatus", 
                   "Dipodomys merriami", 
                   "Microtus oregoni")  # or Microtus pennsylvanicus, etc.

# Filter and create time variable (year-month)
species_data <- data %>%
  filter(Species %in% focal_species) %>%
  mutate(time = paste(Year, Month, sep = "-")) %>%
  select(Neon_site, time, Species, Abundance_estimate) %>%
  drop_na(Abundance_estimate)

# ---------- 2. Aggregate by site + time + species ----------
# Use sum (total abundance per site-month) – change to mean if preferred
agg_data <- species_data %>%
  group_by(Neon_site, time, Species) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance_estimate), .groups = "drop")

# ---------- 3. Pivot to wide format (one column per species) ----------
wide_data <- agg_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0)

# Add a small constant to avoid log(0) later
wide_data <- wide_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(focal_species), ~ . + 0.1))

# ---------- 4. Create lagged abundances within each site ----------
# Sort by site and time, then compute lags
wide_data <- wide_data %>%
  arrange(Neon_site, time) %>%
  group_by(Neon_site) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(focal_species),
                .fns = list(lag1 = ~ lag(.)),
                .names = "{.col}_lag1")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na()   # remove first time point per site where lags are NA

# Check how many time points remain
cat("Number of site‑time observations after lagging:", nrow(wide_data), "\n")
if(nrow(wide_data) < 10) warning("Few observations – results may be unreliable.")

# ---------- 5. Compute log ratios (per capita growth rates) ----------
wide_data <- wide_data %>%
  mutate(
    log_ratio_PM = log(`Peromyscus maniculatus` / `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1`),
    log_ratio_DM = log(`Dipodomys merriami` / `Dipodomys merriami_lag1`),
    log_ratio_MO = log(`Microtus oregoni` / `Microtus oregoni_lag1`)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(starts_with("log_ratio"), is.finite))  # remove infinite values

cat("Observations after removing infinite log ratios:", nrow(wide_data), "\n")

# ---------- 6. Fit competition models with site as fixed effect ----------
# This pools information across sites while accounting for site differences

# Model for Peromyscus maniculatus
lm_compet_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1` +
                   factor(Neon_site),
                   data = wide_data)

# Model for Dipodomys merriami
lm_compet_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1` +
                   factor(Neon_site),
                   data = wide_data)

# Model for Microtus oregoni
lm_compet_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ 
                   `Microtus oregoni_lag1` + 
                   `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + 
                   `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` +
                   factor(Neon_site),
                   data = wide_data)

# ---------- 7. Extract competition coefficients (ignoring site effects) ----------
extract_params <- function(model, sp_name, comp1, comp2) {
  coefs <- coef(model)
  # Coefficients: intercept, own_lag, comp1_lag, comp2_lag, then site dummies
  b0 <- coefs[1]
  b1 <- coefs[2]   # own lag
  b2 <- coefs[3]   # competitor 1
  b3 <- coefs[4]   # competitor 2
  
  r <- b0
  K <- -b0 / b1
  alpha1 <- b2 / b1
  alpha2 <- b3 / b1
  
  # Get p-values for competition terms (from summary)
  pvals <- summary(model)$coefficients[,4]
  p1 <- ifelse(length(pvals) >= 3, pvals[3], NA)
  p2 <- ifelse(length(pvals) >= 4, pvals[4], NA)
  
  data.frame(Species = sp_name, r = r, K = K, 
             alpha_vs_comp1 = alpha1, p_vs_comp1 = p1,
             alpha_vs_comp2 = alpha2, p_vs_comp2 = p2)
}

params_PM <- extract_params(lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus", "Dipodomys", "Microtus")
params_DM <- extract_params(lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys", "Peromyscus", "Microtus")
params_MO <- extract_params(lm_compet_MO, "Microtus", "Peromyscus", "Dipodomys")

competition_results <- bind_rows(params_PM, params_DM, params_MO)

# ---------- 8. Single-species models for comparison ----------
lm_single_PM <- lm(log_ratio_PM ~ `Peromyscus maniculatus_lag1` + factor(Neon_site), data = wide_data)
lm_single_DM <- lm(log_ratio_DM ~ `Dipodomys merriami_lag1` + factor(Neon_site), data = wide_data)
lm_single_MO <- lm(log_ratio_MO ~ `Microtus oregoni_lag1` + factor(Neon_site), data = wide_data)

compare_models <- function(single, compet, sp_name) {
  aic <- AIC(single, compet)
  delta <- aic$AIC[2] - aic$AIC[1]
  anova_p <- tryCatch(anova(single, compet)$`Pr(>F)`[2], error = function(e) NA)
  data.frame(Species = sp_name, AIC_single = aic$AIC[1], 
             AIC_compet = aic$AIC[2], delta_AIC = delta, anova_p = anova_p)
}

comparison <- bind_rows(
  compare_models(lm_single_PM, lm_compet_PM, "Peromyscus"),
  compare_models(lm_single_DM, lm_compet_DM, "Dipodomys"),
  compare_models(lm_single_MO, lm_compet_MO, "Microtus")
)

# ---------- 9. Print results ----------
# ---------- 9. Print results (corrected) ----------
cat("\n========== COMPETITION ANALYSIS RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("\nParameter estimates (r, K, α)\n")
# Round only numeric columns
competition_results_print <- competition_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
print(competition_results_print)

cat("\nModel comparison (single-species vs. competition)\n")
comparison_print <- comparison %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))
print(comparison_print)

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(competition_results)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", competition_results$Species[i]))
  cat(sprintf("  r = %.3f, K = %.1f\n", competition_results$r[i], competition_results$K[i]))
  if(competition_results$p_vs_comp1[i] < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Significant competition from %s (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", 
                names(competition_results)[3], competition_results$alpha_vs_comp1[i], competition_results$p_vs_comp1[i]))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ No significant competition from first competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", 
                competition_results$alpha_vs_comp1[i], competition_results$p_vs_comp1[i]))
  }
  if(competition_results$p_vs_comp2[i] < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Significant competition from second competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", 
                competition_results$alpha_vs_comp2[i], competition_results$p_vs_comp2[i]))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ No significant competition from second competitor (α = %.3f, p = %.4f)\n", 
                competition_results$alpha_vs_comp2[i], competition_results$p_vs_comp2[i]))
  }
}

cat("\n========== END ==========\n")
```
